testcase.name: P-R1: GAME keeps checked subtraction and raw ordering: no wrap-around for tick counters (sections 3, 4)
P-R1: COSMETIC playback evaluates and accepts control events across the wrap; earlier instants are rejected by wrapped order (section 4 [R2])
P-A2: no-op controls return the same object and keep the stored anchor; the next control is checked against that anchor only (section 4 [R2])
P-A3: FOREVER reports AFTER only when the cycle index reaches 2^63 (documented limitation, section 5 [R2])
P-R1: translating a COSMETIC history so that it crosses the wrap changes no bit (section 3 [R2])
P-R1: the wrapping difference d is valid for |true elapsed| < 2^63; d = -2^63 is read as 2^63 ns backwards (section 3 [R2])
P-R1: COSMETIC ticksSince across the Long.MAX_VALUE -> Long.MIN_VALUE wrap is the elapsed time, forwards and backwards (section 3 [R2])
P-R1: domain checks are unchanged: mixing COSMETIC and GAME is an IllegalArgumentException, also near the wrap (sections 3, 4)
P-R1: zero elapsed time is +0.0 everywhere, including at both ends of the long range (section 3 [R2])
